row.notes: Takes the slot manager at career+0xf08 (or a child from its +0x238 list by type check); returns 0 if 10 or more slots in +0x268..+0x270 have +0x171 bit0 clear. Resolves loc_key to text through loc (+0x28 + [loc+0x160]*0x10, vt+0x18), formats it with a counter 1..10 (format 0x1457b9a75) into a 128-char buffer until no slot name (+0x20) matches (0x1429d4d90 used for 5..10). Then for the current slot (id from [mgr+0x280]): if slot+0xd2 is set calls Game_SaveSlotManager_CreateSlot(mgr, name, &id) and returns (rc == 0); otherwise copies the name into the slot inline string (+0x28, ptr +0x20, cap 0x80 at +0x18) and returns 1. Caller 0x141ea58e0: finds the career save by predicate, names the slot with key 0x14576d418, then sets the current game mode. Caller 0x14385ad80: same lookup by driver-career predicate, then flags the save manager (+0x1b0 bit0). Caller Ui_CareerWizard_InvokeStepCallback does the same in the career wizard.
